items.title: Bat on an Acorn Swing
items.alt: A tiny fantasy bat sits in an acorn cap suspended by two short ropes from a twig, wings tucked and feet visible over the rim.
items.description: A tiny fantasy bat sits in an acorn cap suspended by two short ropes from a twig, wings tucked and feet visible over the rim. Useful for woodland storytelling.

items.title: Bat Napping in a Teacup
items.alt: A small bat curls inside one broad lavender teacup, ears and folded wings above the rim, eyes peacefully shut.
items.description: A small bat curls inside one broad lavender teacup, ears and folded wings above the rim, eyes peacefully shut. Useful for quiet time cards.

items.title: Bat Presenting a Daisy
items.alt: A bat hangs from a short branch and offers one broad daisy using a wing thumb hook, the other wing folded close.
items.description: A bat hangs from a short branch and offers one broad daisy using a wing thumb hook, the other wing folded close. Useful for personal thank-you cards.
